about: Changes and deletions said the owner's way, each said in a chat of its own against the exam book, with gold answers written once before any run, in the shape of edits.json: the trade identifiers are the exam book's. 'pick': more than one trade matches, so the program must ask which; the ruler answers with 'answer'. 'choose': the change leaves quantity times price away from the total, so the program must ask which follows; the ruler answers with that amount's name, and 'amounts' are what the proposal must then hold. 'refuse': the program must change nothing and say why. Odd-numbered sentences are the practice half, even-numbered ones the hidden half, of which only totals are printed. Every sentence is invented.

sentences.text: 把我十一月二十号那笔BTC的数量改一下，改成0.00054238。
上次那笔可口可乐的时间不对，应该是下午三点半。
刚才那笔记错了，不要了。
